"""Independent HEAD contract, frozen before the native agent receives its task."""
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path
from collections.abc import Iterator

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from pydantic import HttpUrl
from shortlink.main import create_app
from shortlink.settings import Settings


@pytest.fixture
def app_client(tmp_path: Path) -> Iterator[TestClient]:
    settings = Settings(database_path=tmp_path / "acceptance.db", base_url=HttpUrl("https://trusted.example"))
    with TestClient(create_app(settings)) as client:
        yield client


def create(client: TestClient, code: str = "preview_1") -> None:
    result = client.post("/links", json={"target_url": "https://example.com/path?q=1", "code": code})
    assert result.status_code == 201


def test_health_head_preserves_get_headers_without_body(app_client: TestClient) -> None:
    get = app_client.get("/health")
    head = app_client.head("/health")
    assert head.status_code == get.status_code == 200
    assert head.content == b""
    assert head.headers["content-type"] == get.headers["content-type"]


def test_head_preview_does_not_increment_hits_and_get_still_does(app_client: TestClient) -> None:
    create(app_client)
    for _ in range(3):
        response = app_client.head("/preview_1", follow_redirects=False)
        assert response.status_code == 307
        assert response.headers["location"] == "https://example.com/path?q=1"
        assert response.content == b""
    assert app_client.get("/links/preview_1").json()["hits"] == 0
    assert app_client.get("/preview_1", follow_redirects=False).status_code == 307
    assert app_client.get("/links/preview_1").json()["hits"] == 1


def test_expired_head_is_410_without_hit_or_metadata_regression(app_client: TestClient, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    create(app_client)
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(tmp_path / "acceptance.db")) as connection, connection:
        connection.execute("UPDATE links SET expires_at = ? WHERE code = ?", ("2000-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", "preview_1"))
    head = app_client.head("/preview_1", follow_redirects=False)
    assert head.status_code == 410
    assert head.content == b""
    stats = app_client.get("/links/preview_1")
    assert stats.status_code == 200
    assert stats.json()["hits"] == 0
    assert stats.json()["expires_at"].startswith("2000-01-01")


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("path", "expected"), [("/unknown_1", 404), ("/abc", 422)])
def test_head_missing_and_invalid_keep_error_status(app_client: TestClient, path: str, expected: int) -> None:
    response = app_client.head(path, follow_redirects=False)
    assert response.status_code == expected
    assert response.content == b""
    assert response.headers["content-type"].startswith("application/problem+json")


def test_existing_get_and_stats_still_have_original_semantics(app_client: TestClient) -> None:
    create(app_client)
    assert app_client.get("/links/preview_1").json()["hits"] == 0
    response = app_client.get("/preview_1", follow_redirects=False)
    assert response.status_code == 307
    assert app_client.get("/links/preview_1").json()["hits"] == 1
    assert app_client.delete("/links/preview_1").status_code == 204
    assert app_client.get("/preview_1", follow_redirects=False).status_code == 404
